Title: The Council
Type: membership/composition table
Contains: The Chairman, to be appointed by the Federal Government from amongst prominent social workers permanently residing at Islamabad.; Members of Parliament representing Islamabad Capital Territory; Chief Commissioner, Islamabad Capital Territory, Islamabad; Chairman, Capital Development Authority; three representatives of the Consumers Associations in Islamabad; a representative of the Ministry of Interior who shall not be below the rank of Joint Secretary; a representative of the shopkeepers, vendors or manufacturers as recommended by the Chamber of Commerce and Industries, Islamabad; a representative of the Finance Division who shall not be below the rank of Joint Secretary
